hints.measure: The column read: a key of the closing (N, N-1…) or a role following the comparison the reader applies.
hints.label: Replaces the header derived from the measure. Optional.
hints.hidden: Keeps the column in the template without showing it. Hiding never deletes.

widgetDrawer.title: Title
widgetDrawer.titleHint: {'{N}'} writes the closing month, {'{N:key}'} its key

hints.indicator: The vocabulary term this line displays. Its values come from the closing.
hints.role: Emphasises the line: subtotal, total, or memo. With no role, the line is an ordinary one.
hints.side: Side of the balance sheet the line sits on. Read by the balance sheet renderer only.
hints.reference: Indicator this line is an effect of. The card then shows that indicator's history: an effect has no history of its own and only means something beside what drove it. Leave empty in the usual case.
hints.card: Leaves the card of this line out of the cards renderer. The line stays in the table.

cards.signColored: Colour on the sign of the value

chart.syncLines: Align the lines on the series

hints.color: Colour token of the template. The module picks the ink, the template picks the slot.
hints.type: Bar, or a line plotted against the secondary axis.
hints.group: Label of the group shown under the columns of the composition.
